claude_proposed_widenings.name: fixed_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Potion of Poison has a fixed DC 13 Constitution saving throw printed on the item. No existing DcSource variant represents a fixed numeric DC — caster_spell_save_dc scales with the caster, weapon_attack_dc is 8 + ability + PB, and innate_dc is base + ability_mod + PB. A magic item consumed by a player has no 'caster' to derive from, and the DC does not scale with any character stat.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_potion_of_poison.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
